## Caveat

* [MadGraph defects found by this project](madgraph-defects.md) - Register of MadGraph defects met while validating: where each sits, whether it changes a weight on a card we support, how vibegraph handles it, and its upstream status.
* [Grouped MadEvent sets scales on the unpermuted point](madgraph-permuted-first-call.md) - Grouped DSIGPROC clusters and rejects the unpermuted PP while the matrix element reads P1; vibegraph clusters P1. A registered deviation (H1), with its measured size and reproducer.
* [Partonic sigma is not comparable across some refdata boundaries](refdata-sigma-comparability.md) - A partonic sigma from refdata-2 is not comparable to refdata-3 or later (alpha_s 0.130 vs 0.118), nor are the four re-carded runs across refdata-4 to refdata-5 (up to -9.8%).
* [Rows gated differently from the default, and why](sigma-row-gating-exceptions.md) - Why some rows report rather than assert a statistic (ee_to_mumua's pull, the 2->6 rows, toy-row AQCDUP, pp_to_jj tie-breaks, info cells); open residuals are linked backlog items.

## Design

* [How MadGraph reference runs are made and read](madgraph-reference-runs.md) - Where each reference number comes from (results.dat, standalone dumps, banked events), the run card as shared input, and the MadGraph output behaviours a reader must know.
* [validation/manifest.toml: the per-process source of truth](process-manifest.md) - One committed file names every reference process, its script and per-category tier and mode with rationale; generators, gates and the collator read it and must match its rows.
* [The fetched reference-data bundle](refdata-bundle.md) - Banked MadGraph runs ship as a sha256-pinned release asset with plain-text events; the member list is the contract, and a gate reading an unlisted file passes only locally.
* [Why the designed reference rows exist](reference-row-rationale.md) - The rows built to isolate one feature: ud_to_epemud_qcd0 as the multi-rung spine reference, pp_to_jj as the QCD capstone, and the llj family that splits order spelling, scale and PDF.
* [The toy UFO models as validation instruments](toy-ufo-models.md) - vibegraph_toy_UFO and vibegraph_toy_color_UFO put one Lorentz or colour structure in one vertex, so conventions no SM or SMEFT process isolates are gated against MadGraph.
* [Hermetic, banked and oracle validation layers](validation-layers.md) - Each test declares by its registration which external inputs it may assume; banked gates fail hard on a missing input, and oracle gates are #[ignore] plus a pixi task.
* [The per-process x category validation report and its collator](validation-report.md) - Four per-process categories (diagrams, amplitudes, integrals, samples) plus standalone gates; a cell is the worst recorded measurement and nothing is inferred from a passing suite.

## Design Decision

* [Validation budgets matched to reference precision](budget-alignment-rule.md) - Size each sigma gate so our error is about MadGraph's, subject to seed-scatter and convergence floors that always win.
* [Policy for MadGraph defects](madgraph-defect-policy.md) - A defect that changes a weight on a supported card is reproduced bug-for-bug or refused, never silently fixed; a documented, registered deviation is the user-approved third outcome.
* [References come from pinned MadGraph 3.7.1 with LHAPDF PDF sets](madgraph-oracle-pinning.md) - Reference runs use the pinned submodule (3.7.1), not the packaged 3.5.7, and only LHAPDF sets, since MadGraph's internal nn23lo1 has no oracle here.

## Measurement

* [The pp_to_ll_0j2j_mlm @2 excess decomposed](mlm-at2-excess-decomposition.md) - The split of a +1.94 pb @2 excess into reference, H1, composite and a generic 2->4 offset, what each probe eliminated, and where @2 stands against the independent-directory reference.
* [Seed-sweep headroom of the enforced gate statistics (base 0538e2d)](seed-headroom-census-2026-09.md) - Five-seed headroom of every enforced tolerance and pull/chi2 threshold in the banked layer, read by threshold class; calibrations written before e73b158 no longer reproduce.

## Procedure

* [Measuring a no-change claim: report diffs and binary byte identity](no-change-claims.md) - How 'nothing else moved' is measured: per-cell report JSON and the rendered report diffed in both work-area states, and two binaries in separate targets compared on grids and LHE.
* [Banking and publishing a refdata bundle](refdata-banking-procedure.md) - Classify artifacts, generate on the bank host, check reproduction by findings, gate, assemble twice for byte identity, prove a clean export, publish, flip the pin, re-verify from the bundle.

## Validation Gate

* [Amplitude oracle against MadGraph AMP, JAMP and AMP2](amplitude-oracle.md) - amplitude_oracle compares per point, helicity, diagram and flow with one fitted unit constant per process, asserts MadGraph's AMP2 configuration grouping, and reads banked event momenta.
* [Colour oracles: CF matrix, colour basis and leshouche tags](colour-oracles.md) - The CF matrix and colour-basis order against matrix1_orig.f with structure controls, and color_flow_tags_oracle against every leshouche.inc subprocess plus a slot-legality scan.
* [Which gate pins which convention-sign channel](convention-channel-coverage.md) - Guard processes asserted to exercise every sign branch, mutation experiments per row, and the all-rootings soundness check; which channels have no varying instance.
* [Coupling-level oracle](coupling-oracle.md) - Crate couplings against MadGraph's Python model_reader (the arbiter) and the Fortran COMMON after SETPARA, per banked amplitude row, so a drifting coupling is named before amplitudes move.
* [Kernel correctness and reach: property harness and op census](evaluator-kernel-coverage.md) - Each hand-written kernel is checked fused == generic on typed random inputs, and a per-model two-way census fails when a kernel no gated row reaches, or a listed-uncovered op that is reached.
* [LHEF, unweighting and generate gates](event-output-gates.md) - Byte-for-byte LHEF round trip of the banked runs with mutation controls, validate_unweighting's sigma and shape checks, and end-to-end generate at fixed and proton beams; each blind spot.
* [kT clustering dump oracle](kt-cluster-dump-oracle.md) - Instrumented MadGraph 3.7.1 dumps every candidate, merge, frame change and scale per banked event; validate_kt_cluster must match all of it. What the dump and the gate cannot see.
* [LHAPDF PDF oracle](lhapdf-oracle.md) - gen_oracle.cpp against MadGraph's own LHAPDF 6.5.6 over knot, off-knot, seam, tail and corner categories, an analytic bilinear oracle, and validate_pdf_grid's per-category bars.
* [MLM per-event dump oracle](mlm-dump-oracle.md) - Instrumented MadEvent replay and validate_mlm_dumps: engine replay and production path against both setclscales calls, rewgt factor by factor and the matched record, at 1e-12.
* [Matched MLM comparison through Pythia](mlm-pythia-matched-comparison.md) - Both sides' matched files through one Pythia main164 configuration: acceptance per @N, merged sigma, jet-rate shapes, MadEvent nulls and the <scales> negative control.
* [MLM cross-section gate](mlm-sigma-gate.md) - The five MLM rows: per-@N sigma through the composite integrand against seeded MadEvent references read under the seed policy, the gating rule, and the measured table at refdata-9.
* [SMEFTsim and toy rows in the MadGraph oracle](non-sm-rows.md) - How non-SM rows are banked and gated: per-class restrict cards, order bounds in process strings, interactions.json, the primitive coverage table and the ee > tt~ NP<=1 capstone.
* [The samples gate: event samples against MadGraph's](samples-gate.md) - Weighted KS and chi2 per observable against MadGraph's banked events at P_FLOOR 1e-4 over three seeds, plus beam, scale, polarization and spectrum columns; and what it cannot see.
* [Replaying MadGraph's per-event scales and alpha_s](scale-replay-gate.md) - validate_scales replays each banked run's SCALUP, <rscale> and <pdfrwt> from the momenta and reproduces AQCDUP through the run's alpha_s source; every banked run is classified in its inventories.
* [Cross-section gates against MadGraph](sigma-gate.md) - validate_sigma and validate_hadronic compare sigma through the production integrand under MadGraph's own run card: pull plus rel_tol, multi-seed statistics and the blind spots.
* [Structural censuses against MadGraph](structural-censuses.md) - Diagram counts against matrix<N>_orig.f NGRAPHS (not MAPCONFIG), and the proc-grammar, s-channel, decay-chain and polarization censuses dumped from MadGraph and matched hermetically.

## Validation Methodology

* [Localising an amplitude disagreement with a bit-exact oracle](bit-exact-amplitude-debugging.md) - Match parameter provenance, then compare per-diagram x per-helicity complex amplitudes, fit per-diagram signs (least squares, then a GF(2) solve over diagram features), and verify a fix on the dumps.
* [The finite-field evaluator as an exact oracle](finite-field-evaluator.md) - Running the production evaluator over Z_p with an f64 shadow gives an exact oracle for zeros, per-pair identities and gauge cancellations.
* [Setting gate thresholds and reading headroom](gate-thresholds.md) - Tolerances sit at the algorithm's error scale with measured ulp headroom; tolerances and extremum-of-N statistics read headroom oppositely; margin is bought with points, never by widening.
* [Oracles below sigma for samplers and the hadronic integrand](integrand-and-sampler-oracles.md) - Samplers gate bit-for-bit where order allows and on analytic distributions, with sigma as backstop; the hadronic integrand has a pointwise re-derivation, fixed-s-hat slices and a DY cross-check.
* [Seed policy for MadEvent references](madevent-reference-seed-policy.md) - At least five seeds (ten under a gate tighter than 0.3%), stored per seed, read as an inverse-variance mean with error max(quoted, spread/sqrt n); fresh directories per seed where shared-directory seeds are not independent enough.
* [Oracle blind spots, convention claims and non-vacuity](oracle-blind-spots-and-non-vacuity.md) - Worked cases behind AGENTS.md's validation rules: each oracle's blind spot and what covers it, convention claims pinned by falsifiers, and checks shown able to fire.
* [Pre-registered verdict tables and may-move sets](pre-registered-verdicts.md) - Before measuring, fix the verdict table, the cells allowed to move and the falsifier; then read the measured change against that set, and stop on anything outside it.
* [Seed sweeps, budget ladders and when a pull is asserted](seed-sweeps-and-budget-ladders.md) - A fixed-seed pull is not evidence: sweep five or more seeds and read spread and chi2/dof, add a budget ladder for shared bias, and assert a pull only for fluctuations.
* [Auditing an integral with windowed re-integrations](windowed-partition-closure.md) - A partition of one integration cannot audit it; independently re-surveyed windows on both sides plus a closure test can. Window rules, estimators, statistics, blind spots.
